note: The JSON input is decoded as an OPC UA Variant object controlled by the candidate bytes.
The input-controlled Type field is read from the JSON token and later resolves to the ByteString data type.
The decoded type id 15 selects UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTESTRING] for the Variant body.
The input-controlled Body string has length 3 and is passed to the base64 decoder.
For a non-padded base64 string whose length is not a multiple of four, the decoder computes a positive decoded length although no complete four-character group exists to initialize that many bytes.
The positive decoded length is stored in the ByteString even though the allocated buffer bytes were not written.
Encoding the decoded Variant dispatches the ByteString value to the ByteString JSON encoder.
The ByteString encoder passes the uninitialized decoded buffer and positive length to UA_base64, which reads the uninitialized bytes.
